core_findings: G2−G1 pooled OOF ACC/BA/Prob-AUC differences are +0.23/+0.14/+1.27 percentage points; fold-level ACC/BA intervals cross zero.
G3−G2 pooled OOF ACC/BA rise +0.57/+0.62 pp while Prob-AUC falls 1.32 pp; the medical-prompt advantage is mixed.
G3−B0 pooled OOF ACC/BA/Prob-AUC are −3.90/−3.94/−3.81 pp; excluding Fold 2 does not change the direction.
B0→G3 changes include 20 wrong-to-right and 54 right-to-wrong cases, net −34; this is post-hoc independent-predictor complementarity, not fusion correction.
Dynamic-Off materially changes predictions, but the static-surrogate G1 also uses the added residual path. Temporal shuffling and medical-prompt permutation have small, inconsistent effects.
Dynamic residual magnitude tracks scan length, window count and FD; framewise censor/delete timestamps are unavailable.
experiment: Experiment 80.1 — PSDC End-to-End Dynamic Complementary Learning
next_recommended_step: Do not start Stage B. A future study should first obtain framewise censor/motion metadata and run a preregistered independent-site holdout replication.
scope: First complete PSDC end-to-end validation; not a claim that the MICCAI 2027 innovation is established.
